title: Shillong Peak: Throne of the Gods (U Lum Shillong)
cultural_context: Anthem dedicated to the guardian mountain divinity U 'Lei Shillong, published in 'Ki Jingrwai Khasi'.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko Lum Shillong ba kynjai,
Ba ieng ha shiteng ri,
Kliar jong me ba tap da lyoh
Ka shong ka burom blei;
Me peit ia ki khun ki hajar
Naduh ba sdang pyrthei,
Me synshar ia ki lyer
Bad ki wah ba tuid jai-jai.

Ha pneh jong me ngi ioh
Ka jingsuk bad ka spah,
Ki khlaw kyntang ba khuid
Ba buh ki kpa tymmen;
Wat ha ka pyrthei thymmai
Ngin bat la ka niam ka rukom,
Ban burom ia U Lum Shillong
U kpa jong ka ri baroh.
lyrics_english:
O serene Shillong Peak,
Standing at the centre of the land,
Your summit veiled in clouds
Is home to divine majesty;
You have watched over the populace
From the dawn of creation,
Ruling over the mountain winds
And the tranquil flowing rivers.

In your protective lap we find
Enduring peace and wealth,
The sacred pristine groves
Hallowed by our forefathers;
Even in this modern age
We shall hold our sacred tenets,
Honouring Shillong Peak,
The guardian father of all the realm.
